description: This file contains test cases for the Wishlist API endpoints in a Django project, using pytest. It tests authentication requirements, idempotent add/remove operations, pagination behavior, and user-scoping.

methods.name: test_wishlist_requires_auth(api_client)
methods.description: Tests that accessing the wishlist API requires authentication, expecting 401 or 403 status codes.

methods.name: test_wishlist_add_list_remove_idempotent(api_client, item_factory, auth_headers_for_user)
methods.description: Tests adding an item to the wishlist, idempotency of add and remove operations, and verifies the wishlist contents.

methods.name: test_wishlist_user_scoped(api_client, item_factory, obtain_jwt_tokens, user, user_password)
methods.description: Verifies that wishlist data is scoped per user, ensuring one user cannot see another user's wishlist.
